steps.text: Take Furosemide 40 mg once a day, in the morning
Take Losartan 25 mg once a day
Take Empagliflozin 10 mg once a day
Take Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg twice a day until it is gone (next 3 days)
Stop lisinopril. Keep spironolactone on hold until your doctor says otherwise
Weigh yourself every morning at the same time and write it down with how you feel
Get your kidney and potassium blood test (basic metabolic panel) before or at your first follow-up visit (within 1 week)
See your primary care doctor (within about 1 week)
See your heart doctor (cardiology) (within about 1 week)
Eat a low-salt diet: about 2 grams of sodium a day
Follow the fluid limits the heart-failure team gave you

medications.name: Furosemide
medications.why: A water pill. It helps your body get rid of extra fluid so you breathe easier. You will urinate more; take it in the morning.

medications.name: Losartan
medications.why: Helps your heart and keeps your blood pressure down. It replaces lisinopril.

medications.name: Empagliflozin
medications.why: Helps your heart and your diabetes.

medications.name: Amoxicillin-clavulanate
medications.howOften: twice a day by mouth for 3 more days
medications.why: An antibiotic to finish treating your pneumonia. Take every dose even if you feel better.

medications.name: Metoprolol succinate
medications.why: Slows your heart and helps it pump better.

medications.name: Apixaban
medications.why: A blood thinner that prevents clots from your irregular heartbeat. Watch for bleeding.

medications.name: Atorvastatin
medications.why: Lowers cholesterol to protect your heart.

medications.name: Metformin
medications.why: Controls your blood sugar. Keep taking it as long as your kidney tests stay stable.

medications.name: Lisinopril
medications.why: Stopped. Losartan now does this job, so do not take both.

medications.name: Spironolactone
medications.why: On hold until your doctor checks your kidney and potassium blood tests. Do not restart it on your own.

medications.name: Ibuprofen/other NSAIDs
medications.why: Avoid pain relievers like ibuprofen. They can hurt your heart and kidneys. Ask your doctor before taking any.

followUps.why: Check your recovery, your kidney tests and your medicines
Check your heart failure plan and decide when to restart spironolactone

followUps.when: right away if your weight rises fast
followUps.why: Adjust your water pill before fluid builds up again

warnings.text: Severe shortness of breath, especially at rest
Legs or belly swelling up quickly
Making much less urine than usual
Fever or a cough that gets worse even with the antibiotic
Fast weight gain or more swelling or breathlessness, following the weight plan your heart-failure team gave you
Any bleeding that worries you while taking apixaban
Before starting any new medicine, including over-the-counter pain relievers
